column1: # Generated by tools/generate-openvox-data.py from the OpenVox sources.

column2: The top of the type system. Every value is an Any.
An ordered collection. `Array[String]`, `Array[Integer, 1, 10]` for a size range.
A sequence of bytes, normally produced by `binary_file()` or base64 content.
`true` or `false`.
A lambda or function reference. `Callable[String, Integer]` describes its parameters.
Anything that can appear in a catalog: a Resource or a Class.
A reference to a Puppet class. `Class['apache']`.
An Array or a Hash.
The type of the `default` keyword, used in case options and selectors.
A function call evaluated on the agent rather than in the catalog.
One of a fixed set of strings. `Enum['running', 'stopped']`.
An error value, used with `Deferred` and error handling.
A floating point number. `Float[0.0, 1.0]` constrains the range.
A key-value collection. `Hash[String, Integer]`, with an optional size range.
Accepts whatever the given type can be created from. `Init[Integer, 8]` parses octal strings.
A whole number. `Integer[1, 65535]` constrains the range.
Anything that can be iterated: a collection, a String, an Integer range.
A lazy sequence produced by `reverse_each`, `step` and friends.
Any value except `undef`. `NotUndef[String]` narrows it further.
An Integer or a Float.
The given type or `undef`. `Optional[String[1]]`.
A String matching at least one of the given regular expressions.
A regular expression value. `Regexp[/^a/]` matches one specific pattern.
A reference to any resource. `Resource['file', '/etc/motd']`.
Any value that survives catalog serialisation, including Sensitive and Deferred.
A single value: String, Numeric, Boolean or Regexp.
A Scalar that is safe to serialise as data: String, Numeric or Boolean.
A semantic version. `SemVer['1.0.0', '2.0.0']` constrains the range.
A semantic version range, as used in module dependencies.
Wraps a value so it is redacted from logs and reports. `Sensitive[String[1]]`.
Text. `String[1]` requires at least one character; `String[1, 20]` bounds it.
A Hash with a known shape. `Struct[{ host => String, Optional[port] => Integer }]`.
A Bolt target. Only meaningful in plans.
A duration, produced by `Timespan(...)` or a `{ hours => 2 }` hash.
A point in time, produced by `Timestamp(...)`.
An Array with a known shape. `Tuple[String, Integer, 2, 4]`.
The type of a type. `Type[String]`.
A uniform resource identifier, with optional constraints on its parts.
The type of `undef`.
Accepts any value and converts nothing; rarely used directly.
Any one of the given types. `Variant[String, Integer]`.
